summary: Ocean Power Technologies filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, appointing Tracy Pagliara as Acting President and CEO and Jason Weed as COO, with employment agreements effective immediately. Pagliara receives a base salary up to $400,000, a 75% bonus target, 75% equity target, and 75,000 RSUs. Weed receives similar salary and bonus terms. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing also includes a terminated agreement, a new definitive agreement, and other events. Watch for permanent CEO appointment, equity dilution, and execution risk under interim leadership.
